delete.why: Nothing a user can reach runs this code: every file is an unreachable module.

rebuild.why: Most of its files must move to reach the target: a structural change, not an edit in place.

retain.why: It is already where the target puts it, breaks no layer rule, carries no critical risk, and is simple and unduplicated.

modify.why: Everything else stays, with the named changes: a function too complex to change safely is split in place, a critical risk is fixed in place.
